definitions.explanation: The year two years ago from the present. More formal than the colloquial おととし.

examples.japanese: {一昨年|いっさくねん}の{夏|なつ}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。
examples.english: I moved the summer before last.

examples.japanese: {一昨年|いっさくねん}から{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}している。
examples.english: I've been studying Japanese since the year before last.

examples.japanese: {一昨年|いっさくねん}の{売上|うりあげ}と{比|くら}べると、{今年|ことし}は{大幅|おおはば}に{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Compared to sales from the year before last, this year's have increased significantly.

notes:
USAGE:
{一昨年|いっさくねん} is the formal reading used in writing and formal speech. The colloquial equivalent is おととし, which is more common in everyday conversation. Both mean the same thing.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- おととし / {一昨年|いっさくねん} (year before last)
- {去年|きょねん} / {昨年|さくねん} (last year)
- {今年|ことし} (this year)
- {来年|らいねん} (next year)
- {再来年|さらいねん} (year after next)
- {一昨日|いっさくじつ} / おととい (day before yesterday)
